name: SpankBang
description: SpankBang video platform plugin for Grayjay with pornstar search, recommendations, and improved creator profiles
author: GreyPluginDev

98: MAJOR: Adopt Grayjay's native captcha resolution API (introduced in Patreon plugin v20). When any request hits a Cloudflare challenge the plugin now throws CaptchaRequiredException and Grayjay automatically opens a dedicated captcha webview -- user solves Turnstile once, cf_clearance is captured with the webview's REAL user-agent, and the request is retried transparently. No more 'open sign-in webview from source settings' rituals.
captcha block added to config with cookiesToFind:['cf_clearance'] so the captcha webview auto-closes the moment Cloudflare passes.

authentication.userAgent set to null so Grayjay's sign-in webview uses its native User-Agent (guaranteed match with the webview's actual canvas/WebGL fingerprint -- fixes the 'Verify you are human' infinite loop on Android).

Runtime User-Agent now comes from bridge.authUserAgent / bridge.captchaUserAgent (whichever solved the challenge), with a platform-aware fallback: Android Chrome on the mobile app build, Windows Chrome on the desktop build. Same pattern the Patreon plugin uses since v25.

authentication.loginUrl restored to /users/login (the captcha API now handles the CF challenge separately, so the sign-in webview only has to load the actual login form -- users who WANT to sign in are no longer forced through the homepage first).
cookiesToFind for authentication reverted to session cookies only (no cf_clearance mixed in) since the captcha block now handles CF cookies -- the sign-in webview only closes on real sign-in.
Removed the sec-fetch-user header (Cloudflare bot heuristics flag it on non-navigation requests). sec-fetch-dest kept at 'empty' for API calls.
97: CRITICAL FIX: Cloudflare Turnstile 'Verify you are human' infinite reload loop inside the sign-in webview -- happened because v96 reverted config userAgent back to Windows Chrome while Grayjay's Android WebView is actually Android Chrome.
authentication.userAgent restored to Android Chrome 131 to match Grayjay's Android WebView.
authentication.loginUrl changed from /users/login BACK to https://spankbang.com/.
Plugin runtime API_HEADERS User-Agent aligned with the config UA.
sec-fetch-dest downgraded from 'document' to 'empty' on API/JSON requests.
